```{r, echo=FALSE}
quali <- fb %>%

quali <- quali %>%

                      c("Ãº" = "ú",

resultado <- quali |>
```

###  Descriptors
Descriptors evaluated in the accessions and the two checks.

```{r, echo=FALSE}

quali_2 <- fb %>%
  dplyr::select(c(1:sample, cce, tcvmfp, pv, cva, cv, cvmf, ph, cvs, fs, cda, Cpe, pcs, csco, cscc)) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(cce) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(entry, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    geno = stringr::str_remove(as.character(entry), "UNTRM-335-"),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(
      c("cce","tcvmfp","pv","cva","cv","cvmf","ph","cvs",
        "fs","cda","Cpe","pcs","csco","cscc")
    ))
  )

stopifnot(nrow(quali_2) == 80)

info <- range_read(gs, sheet = "descriptor") %>%
  rename_with(~ iconv(.x, from = "UTF-8", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace_all(.x, "^[^a-zA-Z0-9]+|[^a-zA-Z0-9]+$", "")) %>%
  tidyr::fill(
    c(abbreviatio_sp, abbreviatio_en, descriptors),
    .direction = "down"
  )

norm <- \(x) x %>%
  stringi::stri_trans_nfc() %>%
  stringi::stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") %>%
  stringr::str_replace_all("\\?", "n") %>%
  stringr::str_squish() %>%
  stringr::str_to_lower()

dic_raw <- info %>%
  dplyr::select(cat_es, cat_en) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(cat_es, cat_en) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(cat_es, cat_en, sep = ";") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cat_es = stringr::str_trim(cat_es),
    cat_en = stringr::str_trim(cat_en),
    key = norm(cat_es)
  )

info_diccionario <- dic_raw %>%
  dplyr::distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cat_en = dplyr::case_when(
      cat_es == "Cafe" ~ "Brown",
      cat_es == "Marron" ~ "Dark brown",
      TRUE ~ cat_en
    )
  )

info <- info %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    descriptors = dplyr::case_when(
      abbreviatio_sp == "csco" ~ "Lighter seed coat color",
      abbreviatio_sp == "cscc" ~ "Darker seed coat color",
      TRUE ~ descriptors
    )
  )

quali_en <- quali_2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(-geno, \(v) {
      lab <- stringr::str_remove(v, "^\\d+\\s*")
      info_diccionario$cat_en[
        match(norm(lab), info_diccionario$key)
      ]
    })
  )
```

# Objective 1

## Analysis of morphological diversity using qualitative traits in common bean accessions

Number of observed classes (Na), effective number of classes (Ne), Nei’s gene diversity (He), and Shannon–Weaver diversity index (H′)

```{r, echo=FALSE}

quali <- quali_2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(!geno %in% c("1023", "1095")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(entry = geno)
stopifnot(nrow(quali) == 78)

qt <- quali %>% dplyr::select(
  cce, tcvmfp, pv, cva, cv, cvmf, ph, cvs,
  fs, cda, Cpe, pcs, csco, cscc
)
vars_q <- names(qt)

labs <- info %>%
  dplyr::filter(abbreviatio_sp %in% vars_q) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(abbreviatio_sp, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(abbreviatio_sp, descriptors) %>%
  tibble::deframe()

sum_q <- function(df, v, lab) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      code = readr::parse_number(.data[[v]]),
      key  = norm(stringr::str_remove(.data[[v]], "^\\d+\\s*"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::count(code, key, name = "Na") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(code) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(fi = Na / sum(Na)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(info_diccionario, key, cat_en), by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      `Qualitative trait`           = lab,
      `Phenotypic classes observed` = cat_en
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(`Qualitative trait`, `Phenotypic classes observed`, Na, fi)
}

qtb <- purrr::map_dfr(vars_q, ~ sum_q(quali, v = .x, lab = unname(labs[.x])))

# NEW: control, no untranslated classes
stopifnot(!anyNA(qtb$`Phenotypic classes observed`))

# Índices Nc, Ne, He, H′ con SE e IC 95 %

div_counts <- function(cnt) {
  p <- cnt / sum(cnt)
  p <- p[p > 0]
  c(Ne = 1 / sum(p^2),
    He = 1 - sum(p^2),
    Hp = -sum(p * log(p)) + 0)   
}

boot_div <- function(df, v, B = 2000) {
  d   <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[v]]))
  cnt <- unclass(table(as.character(d$entry), as.character(d[[v]])))  
  est <- div_counts(colSums(cnt))
  bs  <- t(replicate(B, div_counts(
    colSums(cnt[sample.int(nrow(cnt), replace = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]))))
  se  <- apply(bs, 2, sd)
  ci  <- apply(bs, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

  tibble::tibble(
    n_acc = nrow(cnt), Nc = ncol(cnt),
    Ne = est[["Ne"]],
    He = est[["He"]], se_He = se[["He"]], He_lo = ci[1, "He"], He_hi = ci[2, "He"],
    Hp = est[["Hp"]], se_Hp = se[["Hp"]], Hp_lo = ci[1, "Hp"], Hp_hi = ci[2, "Hp"]
  )
}

set.seed(123)
div_tab <- purrr::map_dfr(vars_q, \(v) {
  boot_div(quali, v) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(`Qualitative trait` = unname(labs[v]), .before = 1)
})

# 4. Tabla 
fmt <- qtb %>%
  dplyr::left_join(div_tab, by = "Qualitative trait") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(`Qualitative trait`) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    first = dplyr::row_number() == 1,
    Na    = as.character(Na),
    fi    = sprintf("%.2f", fi),
    Nc          = dplyr::if_else(first, as.character(Nc), ""),
    Ne          = dplyr::if_else(first, sprintf("%.2f", Ne), ""),
    `He ± SE`   = dplyr::if_else(first, sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", He, se_He), ""),
    `He 95% CI` = dplyr::if_else(first, sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", He_lo, He_hi), ""),
    `H′ ± SE`   = dplyr::if_else(first, sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", Hp, se_Hp), ""),
    `H′ 95% CI` = dplyr::if_else(first, sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", Hp_lo, Hp_hi), ""),
    `Qualitative trait` = dplyr::if_else(first, `Qualitative trait`, "")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(`Qualitative trait`, `Phenotypic classes observed`, Na, fi,
                Nc, Ne, `He ± SE`, `He 95% CI`, `H′ ± SE`, `H′ 95% CI`)

# 5.SE e IC 95 % con t de Student
se_ <- \(x) sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
tq  <- qt(0.975, df = nrow(div_tab) - 1)
ci_t <- \(x) sprintf("%.2f–%.2f", mean(x) - tq * se_(x), mean(x) + tq * se_(x))

mrow <- tibble::tibble(
  `Qualitative trait`           = "Mean ± SE",
  `Phenotypic classes observed` = "",
  Na = "", fi = "",
  Nc          = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", mean(div_tab$Nc), se_(div_tab$Nc)),
  Ne          = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", mean(div_tab$Ne), se_(div_tab$Ne)),
  `He ± SE`   = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", mean(div_tab$He), se_(div_tab$He)),
  `He 95% CI` = ci_t(div_tab$He),
  `H′ ± SE`   = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", mean(div_tab$Hp), se_(div_tab$Hp)),
  `H′ 95% CI` = ci_t(div_tab$Hp)
)

Diversity <- dplyr::bind_rows(fmt, mrow)

# Descargar 
Diversity %>% web_table(scrolly = "400px")

writexl::write_xlsx(Diversity, "manuscript/Table-1.xlsx")
```

Phenotypic diversity of qualitative descriptors was evaluated using the number of observed classes (Na), relative frequency (fi), effective number of classes (Ne), Nei’s diversity index (He), and Shannon’s diversity index (H′), with their respective standard errors and 95% confidence intervals.


# Objective 2

## Study of the morphological diversity of quantitative variables of beans accessions and variables with the greatest discriminant contribution

```{r, echo=FALSE}
quanti <- fb %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    c(1:sample, ap50f, ap50m, dt, spad, nrfp, df, dflo, lv, vp,
      dhm, spv, av, ps, ls, as, rp, hc)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(hc = as.numeric(hc)) %>% 
  mutate(hc = hc * 100)

rb <- quanti %>%
  mutate(
    geno = case_when(
      checks == 0 ~ as.character(entry),
      checks == 1 ~ "checks"
    ),
    .after = checks
  ) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(1:sample), as.factor))

vars <- c(
  "ap50f", "ap50m", "dt", "spad", "nrfp", "df", "dflo", "lv",
  "vp", "dhm", "spv", "av", "ps", "ls", "as", "rp", "hc"
)

exp <- rb %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(vars),
      ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(1:sample, all_of(vars))


```

### Augmented design with entries as fixed effects and checks as random effects

The evaluated traits included days to 50% flowering (D50F), flowering duration (FD), stem diameter at 50% flowering (SD), plant height at 50% flowering (PH50F), number of floral racemes per plant (NFC), chlorophyll content at 50% flowering (SPAD), plant height at 90% physiological maturity (PH90M), days to 90% physiological maturity (D90M), number of pods per plant at 90% physiological maturity (NPP), pod width at 90% physiological maturity (PW), pod length at 90% physiological maturity (PL), number of seeds per pod (NSP), seed weight (SW), seed length (SL), seed width (SWd), yield per plant (YP), and harvest index (HI).

The data were analyzed using an augmented design mixed linear model, with entries included as fixed effects and checks included as random effects. Block, row, column, and the entry-by-check interaction were included as random effects to account for variation associated with the experimental design. The model was specified as:

$$
y \sim 0 + (1|block) + (1|rows) + (1|cols) + (1|entry:checks) + geno
$$

where $y$ represents the observed value of each trait; $block$, $rows$, and $cols$ represent random effects associated with the experimental and spatial structure; $entry:checks$ represents the random effect associated with the entry-by-check structure; and $geno$ represents the fixed effect of genotype. The model was fitted separately for each quantitative trait to estimate the effects of the evaluated entries while accounting for variation associated with the experimental design and repeated checks.

```{r, echo=FALSE}

rslt <- 14:length(exp) %>% map(\(x) {
  
trait <- names(exp)[x]

exp %>% 
   tidyr::drop_na(all_of(trait))%>% 
  H2cal(trait = trait
    , gen.name = "geno"
    , rep.n = 1
    , fixed.model = ~ 0 + (1|block) + (1|rows) + (1|cols)+ (1|entry:checks) + geno
    , random.model = ~ 1 + (1|block) + (1|rows) + (1|cols)+(1|entry:checks) + (1|geno)
    , summary = TRUE
    , emmeans = FALSE 
    , plot_diag = TRUE
    , outliers.rm = FALSE
    )

})
tabsmr <- 1:length(rslt) %>% map(\(x) {
      rslt[[x]][["tabsmr"]] 
      }) %>% 
  bind_rows()

blues <- 1:length(rslt) %>% map(\(x) {
      rslt[[x]][["blues"]] %>% dplyr::select(!matches("smith.w"))
      }) %>% Reduce(function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE
                                        , by = c('geno')), .)

blups <- 1:length(rslt) %>% map(\(x) {
      rslt[[x]][["blups"]] %>% dplyr::select(!matches("smith.w"))
      }) %>% Reduce(function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE
                                        , by = c('geno')), .)

tabsmr %>% web_table(scrolly = "400px")
writexl::write_xlsx(tabsmr, "files/STable-4.xlsx")

```

### Adjusted means of checks

Because the checks were repeated across blocks, their adjusted means were estimated using a mixed linear model that accounted for the experimental variation associated with block and column effects. The checks were included as fixed effects, whereas block and column were considered random effects. The model was specified as:

$$
y \sim 0 + (1|block) + (1|cols) + entry
$$

where $y$ represents the observed value of each trait, $block$ represents the random block effect, $cols$ represents the random column effect, and $entry$ represents the fixed effect of the check. The model was fitted separately for each quantitative trait, and adjusted means were obtained as BLUEs (Best Linear Unbiased Estimates) for each check.
 

```{r, echo=FALSE}

checks <- quanti |>
  dplyr::filter(checks == 1) |>
  dplyr::select(1:sample, ap50f, ap50m, dt, spad, nrfp, df, dflo,
                lv, vp, dhm, spv, av, ps, ls, as, rp, hc)

traits <- c(
  "ap50f", "ap50m", "dt", "spad", "nrfp", "df", "dflo", "lv",
  "vp", "dhm", "spv", "av", "ps", "ls", "as", "rp", "hc"
)

exp_chk <- checks |>
  mutate(across(all_of(traits), as.numeric)) |>
  group_by(plots, entry, block, cols) |>
  summarise(across(all_of(traits), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(across(all_of(traits), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA, .x)),
         block = droplevels(block),
         cols  = droplevels(cols))

rslt <- 5:length(exp_chk) %>% map(\(x) {
  
  trait <- names(exp_chk)[x]

  exp_chk %>% 
    tidyr::drop_na(all_of(trait)) %>% 
    H2cal(
      trait = trait,
      gen.name = "entry",
      rep.n = 24,
      fixed.model = ~ 0 + (1|block) + (1|cols) + entry,
      random.model = ~ 1 + (1|block) + (1|cols) + (1|entry),
      summary = TRUE,
      emmeans = FALSE,
      plot_diag = TRUE,
      outliers.rm = FALSE
    )
})


tabsmr_ch <- 1:length(rslt) %>%
  purrr::map(\(x) {
    rslt[[x]][["tabsmr"]]
  }) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()

blues_ch <- 1:length(rslt) %>%
  purrr::map(\(x) {
    rslt[[x]][["blues"]] %>%
      dplyr::select(!matches("smith.w"))
  }) %>%
  Reduce(
    function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE, by = "entry"),
    .
  )

blups_ch <- 1:length(rslt) %>%
  purrr::map(\(x) {
    rslt[[x]][["blups"]] %>%
      dplyr::select(!matches("smith.w"))
  }) %>%
  Reduce(
    function(...) merge(..., all = TRUE, by = "entry"),
    .
  )

tabsmr_ch %>% web_table(scrolly = "400px")

```

### Cluster validation 

```{r, echo=FALSE}

# 1. PCA coordinates of the 78 accessions

datos.pca <- mv$ind$coord

d_pca <- stats::dist(datos.pca)

hc_w <- stats::hclust(
  d_pca,
  method = "ward.D2"
)


# 2. WSS / Elbow method

p_wss <- factoextra::fviz_nbclust(
  datos.pca,
  hcut,
  method = "wss",
  k.max = 10
)

p_wss

wss_k <- p_wss$data

x <- as.numeric(as.character(wss_k$clusters))
y <- wss_k$y

d_line <- abs(
  (y[length(y)] - y[1]) * x -
    (x[length(x)] - x[1]) * y +
    x[length(x)] * y[1] -
    y[length(y)] * x[1]
) /
  sqrt(
    (y[length(y)] - y[1])^2 +
      (x[length(x)] - x[1])^2
  )

k_elbow <- x[which.max(d_line)]


# 3. Silhouette width: k = 2–10

sil_k <- purrr::map_dfr(
  2:10,
  \(kk) {
    cl <- stats::cutree(
      hc_w,
      k = kk
    )

    s <- cluster::silhouette(
      cl,
      d_pca
    )

    tibble::tibble(
      k = kk,
      avg_sil = mean(
        s[, "sil_width"]
      )
    )
  }
)

k_sil <- sil_k$k[
  which.max(sil_k$avg_sil)
]

sil_max <- max(
  sil_k$avg_sil
)

p_sil <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  sil_k,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = k,
    y = avg_sil
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = k_sil,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 2:10
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Average silhouette width"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()

p_sil


# 4. Gap statistic

set.seed(123)

gap_stat <- cluster::clusGap(
  datos.pca,
  FUNcluster = function(x, k) {
    hc <- stats::hclust(
      stats::dist(x),
      method = "ward.D2"
    )

    list(
      cluster = stats::cutree(
        hc,
        k = k
      )
    )
  },
  K.max = 10,
  B = 500
)

gap_table <- as.data.frame(
  gap_stat$Tab
)

gap_table$k <- 1:nrow(
  gap_table
)

k_gap_max <- gap_table$k[
  which.max(gap_table$gap)
]

k_gap_firstmax <- cluster::maxSE(
  gap_table$gap,
  gap_table$SE.sim,
  method = "firstmax"
)

k_gap_SEmax <- cluster::maxSE(
  gap_table$gap,
  gap_table$SE.sim,
  method = "firstSEmax"
)

k_gap_tibs <- cluster::maxSE(
  gap_table$gap,
  gap_table$SE.sim,
  method = "Tibs2001SEmax"
)

p_gap <- factoextra::fviz_gap_stat(
  gap_stat
) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Gap statistic"
  )

p_gap
```

### Correlations among traits

Spearman correlations among the 17 BLUE traits: 136 pairwise tests. p-values were adjusted with the
Benjamini–Hochberg FDR procedure (q-values); 95% CIs of rho come from a bootstrap of accessions.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Análisis de correlación

cuanti_matrix <- acc %>% 
  dplyr::select(2:ncol(acc))

tr_vars <- names(cuanti_matrix)     

cor_df <- combn(tr_vars, 2, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(\(x) {
    
    test <- cor.test(
      cuanti_matrix[[x[1]]],
      cuanti_matrix[[x[2]]],
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
    
    tibble(
      Trait1 = x[1],
      Trait2 = x[2],
      rho = unname(test$estimate),
      p = test$p.value
    )
  }) %>%
  mutate(
    q = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  )

# ---- 95% bootstrap CI of rho ------------------------------------------------
boot_rho <- function(x, y, B = 2000) {
  n <- length(x)
  r <- replicate(B, {
    i <- sample.int(n, replace = TRUE)
    suppressWarnings(cor(x[i], y[i], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
  })
  quantile(r, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
}

set.seed(123)
ci_rho <- purrr::map2(cor_df$Trait1, cor_df$Trait2,
                      \(a, b) boot_rho(cuanti_matrix[[a]], cuanti_matrix[[b]]))
cor_df$rho_lo <- purrr::map_dbl(ci_rho, 1)
cor_df$rho_hi <- purrr::map_dbl(ci_rho, 2)

cor_df %>%
  arrange(q)%>%
  web_table(scrolly = "400px")

cor_df %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    sig_p = sum(p < 0.05),
    sig_q = sum(q < 0.05),
    lost  = sum(p < 0.05 & q >= 0.05) 
  )

cor_df %>%
  filter(p < 0.05, q >= 0.05) %>%
  arrange(q) %>%
  web_table(scrolly = "400px")

cat(sprintf("Of the %d pairwise Spearman correlations, %d were significant at p < 0.05 (unadjusted); after Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction, %d remained significant (q < 0.05) and %d lost significance.\n",
            nrow(cor_df), sum(cor_df$p < 0.05), sum(cor_df$q < 0.05), 
            sum(cor_df$p < 0.05 & cor_df$q >= 0.05)))

write_xlsx(cor_df %>% arrange(q), "files/STable-5.xlsx")


# ---- Figure 3: matrix of correlations with FDR-based stars -----------------

n_tr    <- length(tr_vars)
rho_mat <- q_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, n_tr, n_tr, dimnames = list(tr_vars, tr_vars))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(cor_df))) {
  a <- cor_df$Trait1[i]; b <- cor_df$Trait2[i]
  rho_mat[a, b] <- rho_mat[b, a] <- cor_df$rho[i]
  q_mat[a, b]   <- q_mat[b, a]   <- cor_df$q[i]
}
stars_q <- \(q) ifelse(q < 0.001, "***", ifelse(q < 0.01, "**", ifelse(q < 0.05, "*", "")))
col_id  <- \(x) which(vapply(cuanti_matrix, \(col) isTRUE(all.equal(col, x, check.attributes = FALSE)), logical(1)))[1]

panel_hist <- function(x, ...) {
  usr <- par("usr"); on.exit(par(usr = usr))
  par(usr = c(usr[1:2], 0, 1.5))
  h <- hist(x, plot = FALSE)
  rect(h$breaks[-length(h$breaks)], 0, h$breaks[-1], h$counts / max(h$counts), col = "red")
}
panel_lower <- function(x, y, ...) {
  points(x, y, pch = 21, cex = 0.6)
  abline(lm(y ~ x), col = "blue", lwd = 1)
}
panel_upper <- function(x, y, ...) {
  usr <- par("usr"); on.exit(par(usr = usr))
  par(usr = c(0, 1, 0, 1))
  i <- col_id(x); j <- col_id(y)
  r <- rho_mat[i, j]; q <- q_mat[i, j]
  text(0.5, 0.5, paste0(sprintf("%.2f", r), stars_q(q)), 
       cex = 0.7 + 0.6 * abs(r), col = if (q < 0.05) "black" else "grey50")
}

grid <- \() {
  pairs(cuanti_matrix, 
        lower.panel = panel_lower, upper.panel = panel_upper, diag.panel = panel_hist,
        gap = 0.3, cex.labels = 1.1,
        main = "Spearman rho; * q<0.05, ** q<0.01, *** q<0.001 (Benjamini-Hochberg FDR)")
}

pg <- grid %>% 
  plot_grid()

ggsave2(plot = pg, filename = "manuscript/Figure_4.jpg"
        , width = 30
        , height = 30
        , units = "cm")
pg
```


##  Tabla 2: Presents descriptive statistics for the quantitative traits evaluated in the blues dataset. For each trait, the table reports the mean, minimum, maximum, coefficient of variation (CV%) and broad-sense heritability (H²), providing a summary of the central tendency, range, relative variability and genetic determination of the measured characteristics.

```{r, echo=FALSE}

bluesmeans <- acc

bluesmeans %>% dplyr::select(c(2:18)) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(.x < 0, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "trait", values_to = "n_negative_BLUEs") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(n_negative_BLUEs > 0)

rl <- bluesmeans %>%
  dplyr::select(c(2:18)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(.x < 0, 0, .x))) %>%
  summarise(across(
    everything(),
    list(
      Mean = ~round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Min  = ~round(min(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Max  = ~round(max(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      `CV(%)` = ~round(sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 2)
    )
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Quantitative trait", "stat"),
    names_pattern = "^(.*)_(Mean|Min|Max|CV\\(%\\))$",   
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stat,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(Mean:`CV(%)`, ~formatC(.x, format = "f", digits = 2))) 

# ---- Broad-sense heritability (H2.s) ----
stopifnot("H2.s" %in% names(tabsmr))

map_abbr <- info %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(abbreviatio_sp)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(abbreviatio_sp, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(abbreviatio_sp, abbreviatio_en)

h2_tab <- tabsmr %>%
  dplyr::left_join(map_abbr, by = c("trait" = "abbreviatio_sp")) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    `Quantitative trait` = abbreviatio_en,
    H2 = sprintf("%.2f", H2.s)
  )

rl <- rl %>%
  dplyr::left_join(h2_tab, by = "Quantitative trait")

stopifnot(!any(is.na(rl$H2)))

rl %>% web_table()
writexl::write_xlsx(rl, "manuscript/Table-2.xlsx")

```

# Objective 3
## Identification of promising accessions 

```{r, echo=FALSE}

# 78 accessions and 2 checks, both from BLUEs (same scale)
acc_p    <- blues_date %>% dplyr::filter(!geno %in% c("1023", "1095"))
checks_p <- blues_date %>% dplyr::filter(geno %in% c("1023", "1095"))
stopifnot(nrow(acc_p) == 78, nrow(checks_p) == 2)

# A-priori criterion: YP above the best control AND SW >= best control
ref_yp <- max(checks_p$YP, na.rm = TRUE)
ref_sw <- max(checks_p$SW, na.rm = TRUE)

# Equal-weight index (z-scores computed on the 78 accessions)
acc_p <- acc_p %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    index   = as.numeric(scale(YP)) + as.numeric(scale(SW)) + as.numeric(scale(HI)),
    Cluster = clus[geno]
  )

prom <- acc_p %>%
  dplyr::filter(YP > ref_yp, SW >= ref_sw) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(index)) %>%
  dplyr::select(geno, Cluster, YP, SW, HI, D50F, D90M, NPP, index)


prom %>% knitr::kable(digits = 2,
  caption = "Accessions with YP above the best control and SW >= best control, ranked by index")

# Top 4 to feature in the main-text Figure 2
top4 <- prom %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 4)
top4 %>% knitr::kable(digits = 2, caption = "Selected promising accessions (top 4 by index)")
```

## Identification of Promising Accessions Using MFA

```{r, echo=FALSE}
datos <- STable1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(!geno %in% c("1023", "1095")) %>%     # ONLY CHANGE: 78 accessions
  dplyr::select(geno, GH, D50F, D90M, NPP, YP, SW, HI, PH90M, SD)

rownames(datos) <- datos$geno
datos$geno <- NULL
datos$GH <- as.factor(datos$GH)

stopifnot(nrow(datos) == 78, !anyNA(datos))

mfa <- MFA(
  datos,
  group = c(1, 2, 6),
  type = c("n", "s", "s"),
  name.group = c("Morphology","Phenology","Yield"),
  graph = FALSE
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
mfa_var <- plot(mfa, choix = "var", cex = 0.8)
mfa_ind <- plot(mfa, choix = "ind"
            , cex = 0.8
            , habillage = 1)

plot1 <- plot_grid(mfa_var, mfa_ind,
                  nrow = 1, labels = "auto")

  ggsave2(plot = .
          , "manuscript/Figure_5.jpg"
          , units = "cm", width = 40, height = 15)

p1 %>% include_graphics()

round(mfa$eig[1:3, ], 2)               # variance Dim1-3
```

# Supplementary multivariate framework for mixed data 

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide'}
library(FactoMineR); library(missMDA); library(cluster); library(factoextra)

# 1. Data: 17 BLUEs + 14 qualitative descriptors (English), 78 accessions
chk <- c("1023", "1095")
quant <- blues_date %>% dplyr::filter(!geno %in% chk) %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("geno")
qual  <- quali_date %>% dplyr::filter(!geno %in% chk) %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("geno")
qual  <- qual[rownames(quant), ]
qual  <- qual[, sapply(qual, \(x) dplyr::n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1)]   # drop constant traits
qual  <- qual %>% dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), factor))
stopifnot(nrow(quant) == 78, all(rownames(quant) == rownames(qual)))

cat("NA in qualitative descriptors:", sum(is.na(qual)), "\n")

# 2. Standardisation: Z-score vs Min-Max
z  <- scale(quant)
mm <- apply(quant, 2, \(x) (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x)))
pca_z  <- PCA(as.data.frame(z),  ncp = 5, graph = FALSE)
pca_mm <- PCA(as.data.frame(mm), ncp = 5, scale.unit = FALSE, graph = FALSE)
cat("Correlation of PC1-PC2 scores, Z vs Min-Max:",
    round(abs(diag(cor(pca_z$ind$coord[, 1:2], pca_mm$ind$coord[, 1:2]))), 3), "\n")

# 3. Dimension reduction: PCA, MCA, FAMD, PCoA (Gower); missing values imputed
mix <- cbind(quant, qual)
nb  <- missMDA::estim_ncpFAMD(mix, ncp.max = 5)$ncp
mix_imp <- missMDA::imputeFAMD(mix, ncp = max(nb, 1))$completeObs
mix_imp[names(qual)] <- lapply(mix_imp[names(qual)], factor)

mca  <- MCA(mix_imp[names(qual)], ncp = 5, graph = FALSE)
famd <- FAMD(mix_imp, ncp = 5, graph = FALSE)
gow  <- daisy(mix_imp, metric = "gower")
pcoa <- cmdscale(gow, k = 5, eig = TRUE); pos <- pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0]

cum <- \(r, n) sum(r$eig[1:n, 2])
var_expl <- tibble::tibble(
  Method = c("PCA (Z-score)", "PCA (Min-Max)", "MCA", "FAMD", "PCoA (Gower)"),
  `Dim1-2 (%)` = c(cum(pca_z, 2), cum(pca_mm, 2), cum(mca, 2), cum(famd, 2), sum(pos[1:2]) / sum(pos) * 100),
  `Dim1-3 (%)` = c(cum(pca_z, 3), cum(pca_mm, 3), cum(mca, 3), cum(famd, 3), sum(pos[1:3]) / sum(pos) * 100)
)
knitr::kable(var_expl, digits = 1, caption = "Variance explained (not directly comparable across methods)")

Xf <- famd$ind$coord; df <- dist(Xf)
sil_hc <- \(d, m, sp, lb) {
  hc <- hclust(d, m)
  tibble::tibble(space = sp, method = lb, k = 2:10,
                 sil = sapply(2:10, \(k) mean(silhouette(cutree(hc, k), d)[, 3])))
}
set.seed(123)
sil_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  sil_hc(df,  "ward.D2", "FAMD",  "Ward"),
  sil_hc(df,  "average", "FAMD",  "UPGMA"),
  tibble::tibble(space = "FAMD", method = "k-means", k = 2:10,
                 sil = sapply(2:10, \(k) mean(silhouette(kmeans(Xf, k, nstart = 50)$cluster, df)[, 3]))),
  sil_hc(gow, "ward.D2", "Gower", "Ward"),
  sil_hc(gow, "average", "Gower", "UPGMA"),
  tibble::tibble(space = "Gower", method = "PAM", k = 2:10,
                 sil = sapply(2:10, \(k) mean(silhouette(pam(gow, k, diss = TRUE)$clustering, gow)[, 3])))
)
best <- sil_all %>% dplyr::group_by(space, method) %>% dplyr::slice_max(sil, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(sil))
knitr::kable(best, digits = 3, caption = "Best k by average silhouette")

set.seed(123)
gap_wd <- clusGap(Xf, FUN = hcut, K.max = 10, B = 500, hc_method = "ward.D2")
gap_km <- clusGap(Xf, FUN = kmeans, K.max = 10, B = 500, nstart = 25)
k_gap  <- c(Ward   = maxSE(gap_wd$Tab[, "gap"], gap_wd$Tab[, "SE.sim"], "firstSEmax"),
            kmeans = maxSE(gap_km$Tab[, "gap"], gap_km$Tab[, "SE.sim"], "firstSEmax"))
print(k_gap)

k_sel <- best %>% dplyr::filter(space == "FAMD", method == "Ward") %>% dplyr::pull(k)
cl_famd <- factor(cutree(hclust(df, "ward.D2"), k_sel))
print(table(FAMD_Ward = cl_famd, PCA_HCPC = clus[rownames(Xf)]))
cat("Adjusted Rand index:",
    round(mclust::adjustedRandIndex(as.integer(cl_famd), clus[rownames(Xf)]), 3), "\n")

d3 <- as.data.frame(famd$ind$coord[, 1:3]); names(d3) <- c("Dim1", "Dim2", "Dim3")
d3$cluster <- cl_famd; d3$accession <- rownames(d3); pct <- famd$eig[1:3, 2]

p2d <- ggplot2::ggplot(d3, ggplot2::aes(Dim1, Dim2, colour = cluster)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2) + ggplot2::stat_ellipse(level = 0.9, linetype = 2) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = sprintf("Dim 1 (%.1f%%)", pct[1]), y = sprintf("Dim 2 (%.1f%%)", pct[2])) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
cowplot::ggsave2("files/SFigure-3_FAMD-2D.jpg", p2d, units = "cm", width = 18, height = 14)

p3d <- plotly::plot_ly(d3, x = ~Dim1, y = ~Dim2, z = ~Dim3, color = ~cluster, text = ~accession,
                       type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers", marker = list(size = 4))
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(p3d, "files/SFigure-5_FAMD-3D.html", selfcontained = TRUE)

writexl::write_xlsx(list(variance = var_expl, silhouette = sil_all, best_k = best), "files/STable-7.xlsx")
p2d
```
